summary: An Arkansas resident and electric customer files a short public comment in the MISO show cause docket urging FERC to keep transparency, cost responsibility and protection of existing customers central as large loads grow.
ask: Keep transparency, cost responsibility, reliable planning and protection of existing customers at the center of FERC's consideration of large loads.

points.point: The commenter names four priorities for FERC's work on large loads such as data centers.
points.quote: keep transparency, cost responsibility, reliable planning, and protection of existing customers at the center of its consideration of rapidly growing large loads such as data centers.

throughLine.text: Public comment in the E-8 docket on the transparency and cost-responsibility concerns the MISO show cause order raises.
